name: The Heart of Fury

date.label: Burning Crusade quest chronology; exact in-world dating unknown

summary: At Ata’mal Terrace, the seeker recovers the Heart of Fury. Akama recognizes it from Velen’s past and weighs the power it might give him against his people’s freedom. The quest account makes his choice clear: he will not free the Broken only to take Illidan’s place as their master. He sends the artifact onward to A’dal. This refusal gives the hidden plan its clearest purpose.
